baseline.valuation_basis: Reconstructed equivalent assembled-build value; no exact fully assembled Jensen retail quote found. Prices are economic proxies, not a physically qualified shopping list.

lines.notes: One inclusive constructed-airframe allowance, anchored to $279.99 HAN2345 ARF plus $70.01 planning allowance for historical construction/gear/installation differences. Includes film, fixed tricycle gear, tank, mount, spinner, linkage and hardware; no separate bills for those within this full-build value. Not a quote or HAN2345 package-content claim. Range is a planning assumption; exact Jensen replacement or repair recipes need sourcing.

55AX with included muffler values the historical MAX-61FX/E-4010 group approximately. No actual substitution, mounting or performance compatibility asserted. Range is an estimated replacement-cost uncertainty, not observed market extrema. Backorder prevents an immediate full-build purchase.

Three generic physical servos valued at the SC-0252MG+ unit offer. CAR application listing and only two units in stock; neither airplane approval nor availability for a complete four-servo set is established. Original hardware remains unchanged.
One central servo, not one for each aileron. Same economic-only proxy and stock/compatibility limitations as the fuselage group.
Generic receiver valued using a current 8-channel product. Does not enable stabilization, change radio protocol or install this receiver in the simulation.
Matches physical APC 12x6 Sport LP12060; visual wooden finish is not a separate product identity.
Unsourced planning allowance for generic 4.8 V NiMH pack. Exact 600mAh pack quote still needed; no LiPo substitution.
Unsourced allowance: declared 150 ml half-tank contents at assumed $20/litre, not a gallon purchase. No fuel salvage credit.

Paid-labor scenario: 5 hours at assumed $25/hour. Low/high assumptions are 3h at $20 and 6h at $35. Electronics/powerplant installation and commissioning, not construction/covering already in the airframe allowance. DIY cash mode excludes this line. No current shop labor quote was found.

inventory_exclusions.reason: Numerical reference-build balancing mass; no purchasable item. Remains part of physical kinetic energy.

worked_case_inputs.servo_credit_basis: Avoided new purchase in the reconstructed component-built replacement only. Conditional simulated inspection passed; no claimed survival probability.
worked_case_inputs.inspection_labor_note: Example assumes inspection/refit is included in the $125 commissioning allowance. Real service fees remain unsourced, not known to be zero.

covering_patch.notes: Covering-only arithmetic fixture; no rib/spar damage, one color, no extra adhesive. Stale out-of-stock trim sheet price; not a current procurement quote. Overlap/waste/time are gameplay estimates, not certified repair instructions.

research_only_specimens.notes: Synthetic electric Stiks, alternate-prop fixtures and noncatalog HX-700 electric experiments need separate installation evidence before any product valuation. Future drones/EDF aircraft use their own contracts, not inferred catalog prices.
